_readme: Each case feeds `keys` into a fresh Engine and checks the fields present in `expect`. `source` says where the expected value comes from: a manual worked example (page-cited) is a documentary reference; 'formula (Appendix D)' means hand/independently computed from the manual's published formula, not merely 'whatever the code outputs'; 'stdlib (datetime)' means Python's own date arithmetic, not HP-specific. NONE of these are hardware-verified yet -- see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. When the user supplies real HP-12C outputs, those fixtures take priority over any case here that disagrees.
